_readme: Artwork for the roadside hoardings. Edit a board's src and reload - nothing
in index.html needs touching. A src is anything an can load: a file
beside index.html, a path into a folder, a full URL, or a data: URI.
Boards not listed here fall back to "default". A src that fails to load
leaves that board showing whatever it was built with, so a typo costs you
one board rather than the scene.
"draw" is the pixel size the board's canvas is, i.e. what to draw for it.
Artwork of any shape works - it is fitted to the board over its own
background colour rather than stretched - but matching gets you the
sharpest result. Where a board stands, and how big it is, is set by ADS in
index.html; this file is only what goes on it.
